text: Based on the tool output, the property in question, identified as ASSET-F47, was monitored for fire activity from October 5, 2026, to November 4, 2026. The analysis used data from NASA FIRMS, which includes active fire and thermal anomaly detections from various sensors. Throughout the monitored period, there were no fire detections intersecting the asset. Although coverage was not complete on the last day due to data not yet being published, the property remained free of fires during the period covered by the sensors.
